title: Definition of Severity and Descriptors of Chronic Prurigo – Harmonization of European Prurigo Documentation
summary: Chronic Prurigo is an independent disease that is associated with several symptoms that are trying for patients. CPG can be devided into various subtypes and lesions can be distinguished by their number, distribution and the presence of crusts. Medical care and therapy of patients with CPG are challening, as there is no standardized, internationally uniform, medical-dermatological recording of skin diagnosis, clinical definition of severity and distribution of sensory symptoms. Therefore, this study aims to validate documentation forms and to define the severity of CPG to standardize the recording and to simplify the therapy. Within this study a ""patient reported outcome tool"" shall be validated throughout Europe in order to strive for a uniform process together with documentation forms.
